detail.longDescription:
FileRecover is an all-in-one file recovery, storage cleaner, QR scanner, barcode reader, and Safe Vault tool for Android.

Scan your device storage to find photos, videos, audio files, documents, APK/ZIP files, and hidden files that may still be available on your device. Preview supported files, restore selected items, and manage restored files in one place.

Key features:
- File recovery scan for photos, videos, audio, documents, APKs, ZIP files, and hidden files
- Quick Scan and Deep Scan modes
- Preview images, videos, audio, text, PDF, and document information
- Restore selected files to your device storage
- Restored file history with search, sort, share, and delete tools
- File Cleaner for large files, duplicate photos/videos, and old downloads
- QR code scanner and barcode reader
- Detect links, phone numbers, email, SMS, Wi-Fi, contacts, locations, text, product barcodes, and bank transfer QR codes
- QR generator with save, share, and local history
- Safe Vault to move selected files into local protected storage
- Hidden file scan
- Smart scan reminders
- Multi-language support

FileRecover is designed for simple, private, on-device file management. Core scan, cleanup, QR/barcode, and vault features work mainly on your device.

Important: recovery results depend on files still being available or accessible in your device storage. The app does not guarantee recovery of permanently deleted or overwritten data.
